title: Childhood UFO and nasal brain implant at age five

tellings.quote: Uh I remember having experience at age five where um I think that's when they put the brain implant in

plain: Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects he believes are alien implants in human bodies, says that at age five, in Oxnard, California, he had an experience with a UFO. He tells Michels he thinks that is when "they" put an implant into his brain through his nose, which, if true, would make him one of the people he studies.
